back: The buying and selling of goods and services over electronic networks, especially the internet.
All business activities done using electronic networks, including ordering from suppliers and customer service, not only selling.
B2C: business to consumer. B2B: business to business. B2G: business to government. C2C: consumer to consumer.
Websites, social media, search marketing, email and mobile messages, and influencers. Most can be targeted and measured.
Cost per order = promotion cost ÷ number of orders.
Wider reach, open all hours, lower costs, customer data, easy to measure promotion.
Security and fraud, delivery cost and delay, customer trust, returns, unequal access to internet and power.
Digital goods are delivered electronically at once. Physical goods still need warehouses, transport and delivery.
